## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who has this problem (admins, owners, viewers)?

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about.

## Security considerations

TrustVault is security-first. Does this change who can see or do anything?
Does it touch authorization, auditing, or file access? If yes, explain how
the existing invariants (see CONTRIBUTING.md) are preserved.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or examples welcome.
